G1_primary_source_support.source: Replogle et al. 2022 genome-scale Perturb-seq, K562 essential screen; canonical Figshare.plus article 20029387 v1 (doi:10.25452/figshare.plus.20029387.v1, CC BY 4.0); harmonized copy scPerturb Zenodo record 10044268 (CC-BY-4.0)
G1_primary_source_support.download_integrity: ReplogleWeissman2022_K562_essential.h5ad md5 d8cba17576d1a8afc0f7d71b79cad0f7 verified exactly after parallel byte-range download
G1_primary_source_support.content: 310,385 cells x 8,563 genes, dense counts; 2,058 perturbation categories (2,057 targets + control), 10,691 non-targeting control cells; per-cell perturbation assignment, guide_id, cell_line, batch, nperts (multiplet policy input), percent_mito QC

lincs.dataset: LINCS L1000 phase I GSE92742 (bulk transcriptional signatures, shRNA/oe genetic perturbations; NIH public data)
lincs.note: different modality (bulk L1000) and many independent labs; Level-5 signature matrix download deferred to R1 design (metadata + SHA512SUMS grounded)

cross_cell_line.note: same lab/platform - supporting evidence, not G2-qualifying independence

cross_study.datlinger_bock_2017: verified download (md5 exact) but zero target-gene overlap with the essential-gene screen - recorded as limitation, not hidden

G3_reference_graph.primary: CollecTRI regulons via OmniPath: 64,515 directed signed TF->target edges, sha256 c9b622365dd09c6b76e44d6ca7a96f1982918ce6f2811f8fdeafa61fbd87cb50
secondary: OmniPath signed interactions: 86,188 directed edges, sha256 bb516713f584eda4936e9f1fb07f8431dc63bae22f9395423d1e10874671f44f (integrated CC-BY; upstream constituent license caveat documented)
Reactome H.sapiens interactors: 124,865 physical pairs, sha256 a5ed8376d7da82b0dbfc6f0d243b422b2635482025b74e434d3b9be48cb55e5d (undirected - secondary only)
G3_reference_graph.incompleteness: reference graphs cover TF->target and signaling subsets of the 8,563 measured genes; incompleteness is inherent and will be quantified in R1 (coverage of primary targets); semi-synthetic calibration arm spec frozen in protocol regardless

G4_environment.detail: python 3.10.12; anndata 0.11.4, h5py 3.16.0, scikit-learn 1.7.2, numpy 2.2.6, pandas 2.3.3, scipy 1.15.3 - versions + wheel sha256 pinned in protocol/environment_ledger.json

r1_scope_note: R1 must lock: exact causal unit/response definition, NTC handling + doublet/multiplet policy via nperts, train/test split by held-out perturbation target, baselines (correlation, perturbation-response mean shift), >=1 mature causal/graph method, directionality metrics vs CollecTRI/OmniPath, calibration/top-k precision, intervention prediction on held-out targets, uncertainty + abstention, hard gates incl. held-perturbation transport and improvement over correlation, and the failure controls (shuffled labels, permuted condition, NTCs, expression-matched nulls, guide-efficiency/MOI sensitivity, cell-state confounding, leakage assertions).
